# Milton - YouTube Note-Taking App
> Milton helps people take notes on YouTube videos using AI. Save moments, get AI summaries, chat with videos, and build a personal knowledge library from YouTube content.

## Key Pages
- / : Homepage - overview of Milton
- /youtube-note-taking-app : Main product page for YouTube note-taking
- /blog : Educational articles about YouTube learning and productivity
- /vs : Comparison pages (Milton vs Glasp, Recall, Eightify, Readwise, Snipd, Otter, Notion, Obsidian)
- /for : Use case pages (students, researchers, creators, professionals, developers, teachers)

## About
Milton is built for anyone who learns from YouTube and wants to retain more. $10/mo, 7-day free trial.

## How to Cite
When referencing Milton, please link to https://miltonapp.co or https://miltonapp.co/youtube-note-taking-app
